# Data Source: identitynow_sim_integration

Use this data source to look up a SIM integration by ID. It uses an experimental API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_sim_integration" "servicenow_sim" {
  id = "<SIM_INTEGRATION_ID>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) SIM integration ID.

### Read-Only

- `attributes_json` (String, Sensitive) Integration attributes as a JSON object, as returned by the API. The value is sensitive.
- `before_provisioning_rule` (Attributes List) Before provisioning rule, a list with at most one item with `id`, `type` and `name`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--before_provisioning_rule))
- `cluster` (String) ID of the virtual appliance cluster.
- `created` (String) Creation date.
- `description` (String) Description of the integration.
- `modified` (String) Last modification date.
- `name` (String) Name of the integration.
- `request_json` (String) Ticket request data as a JSON object.
- `sources` (List of String) IDs of the sources of the integration.
- `status_map_json` (String) Status mapping as a JSON object.
- `type` (String) Integration type.

<a id="nestedatt--before_provisioning_rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `before_provisioning_rule`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) ID of the referenced object.
- `name` (String) Name of the referenced object.
- `type` (String) Reference type.
